title: Seating order of the street brass band
summary: Long back-and-forth sorting out how trumpets, trombones, tuba, baritone, clarinet and drums lined up marching.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation
